content: Reyansh Tiwari discusses his policy renewal with insurance agent Karan Joshi. He confirms acceptance of the Enhanced bundle for $1,305, verifies that liability limits remain at $100k/$300k, and requests a secure email link to process his payment after the call.

action_items: Karan Joshi to email a secure payment link to the customer
Reyansh Tiwari to complete the payment via the secure link after the call
